dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Back in Mondstadt, our transport balloons always have an Anemo Slime inside them... or at least something that looks just like one.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I used to love picking up this one commission from Katheryne called "Safe Conduct."

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: All the monsters would just rush straight for me, totally ignoring the balloon! Haha...
